recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-25931 unless a future work-group issue separately reopens broader request/response pattern wording.
issue_request: FHIR-25931 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core clarification asking that the Messaging overview change "request message" to "message" so the page would not imply FHIR messaging is limited to request/query use cases.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied by commit 562c106831636d24a05615e84f5078c6e30b578d, which changed source/messaging.html on the exact introductory sentence. The Jira comment cites merge commit a025c2778d5da2f84cbc38293068120e43c12be6, which incorporated the branch but did not itself touch source/messaging.html.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2020-04-20 record the same resolution and 9-0-0 motion. The current source/messaging.html page remains an active top-level documentation page linked from source/documentation.html and source/conformance-rules.html. Later messaging edits did not reintroduce the obsolete introductory wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/messaging.html:20 says "In FHIR messaging, a \"message\" is sent from a source application to a destination", and the old introductory "request message" sentence is absent.
